method: Shared rank-64 Bridge + layer EMD, then sampled-token OPD (sequential)
bridge_calibration: 2000 existing OPRD pairs; same 1800/200 split; shared teacher PCA over all 36 layers; per-student-layer P_S fitted 20 epochs; both frozen during distillation
deviation: Compressed-space EMD changes the objective; not an exact BERT-EMD or EOPD reproduction
projector: frozen per-student-layer Linear(2048,64,bias=False) into one shared teacher PCA coordinate system
layer_states: HF hidden_states[1:] including final post-RMSNorm entry
response_positions: all valid response token positions, no prediction shift
transport: one exact unregularized balanced LP per global optimizer minibatch
optimizer: student AdamW unchanged; frozen bridge has no gradients or optimizer moments; empty-state optimizer retained for checkpoint/update compatibility
hardware_scope: single GPU only; two-pass global minibatch cost then fixed-flow differentiable recomputation
projector_initialization: separately calibrated shared-coordinate bridge; frozen and SHA-256 locked
stage_2_optimizer: fresh AdamW with fresh cosine schedule
